card.name: Odd letters inside rare names
card.fires_on: Short letter chunks like qv, v, ov, gr or j in the middle of a rare proper name or brand name. The chunk is usually a consonant-heavy piece such as the qv in Lindqvist or the V in ORGOVYX.
